messages:
maria: heads up — a terraform apply in ci failed mid-upload to S3. backend compaction got halfway and the DynamoDB lock is stuck.
leo: seeing the same. gpu-pool provisioning in us-west-2 is blocked by the apply lock :grimacing:
maria: exact error from CI log: ```Error: failed to upload statefile: multipart upload aborted (etag mismatch)``` then terraform left a lock id `lock-3a9f...`
sre-jen: can we force-unlock? `terraform force-unlock lock-3a9f...` or delete from Dynamo directly?
devops-aaron: terraform force-unlock would work from the workspace where terraform clients can see the same backend. CI runner was ephemeral so it couldn't finish.
chandra: if you can't run force-unlock, we removed the item from the `terraform-locks` table manually last time with `aws dynamodb delete-item --table-name terraform-locks --key '{"LockID": {"S": "lock-3a9f..."}}'` — careful, only after confirming no apply is running.
leo: who has the apply tracer? need to be 100% sure no running apply before delete.
ops-bot: incident note created: INC-2026-1123 - orphaned tf lock blocking gpu provisioning (assigned: chandra)
maria: i'm on it, checking CI runners and the pipeline. if clear i'll remove the lock and re-run the apply.
sre-jen: quick mitigation: mark the GPU autoscaler to ignore pending capacity on that cluster so other pools can pick up load. Doing it now.
devops-aaron: after delete, we should run `terraform refresh` + `terraform plan` in a dry run on a dev workspace to ensure state integrity.
chandra: confirmed no active CI apply. i ran the dynamodb delete-item and lock is gone.
leo: re-triggered the pipeline. apply started, now in plan stage :crossed_fingers: 
maria: apply completed ✅. gpu pool scaled and new nodes came up.
sre-jen: root cause: S3 multipart finalization failed under high concurrency during state compaction. mitigation: (1) increase s3 put retry/backoff, (2) enable terraform's `state_file_compaction=false` for heavy concurrent workspaces, (3) add a CI runner step to run `terraform state push` if partial uploads detected.
devops-aaron: also adding a small lock TTL grace and alerting on orphan locks > 10m.
leo: thanks everyone. filing follow-up doc in infra-runbook and a retrospective in #postmortems.
maria: thanks — and sorry for the late-night paddles :coffee:
